title: Thirdway header
description: A fixed header floating over the page: a cream wordmark box with a sand menu square (on phones a full-width cream bar that also holds the call to action), a live circled-digit clock at the left and an arrow call to action at the right from tablet up. The menu square opens a cream panel of large links.
notes: fixed to the window and floats over photos: the clock and the call to action use mix-blend-difference so they stay legible on cream and on photography
the clock needs JavaScript (shows 00:00 until it hydrates)
the original's menu overlay content is not rebuilt: a simple panel of links stands in
